task_groups.title: Implement SSE connection manager and broadcaster (internal/audit/sse.go)

subtasks.title: Create internal/audit/sse.go with SSEManager struct and connection registration
details: Define SSEManager struct with: broadcast chan interface{}, connections map[connID]*sseConn, mu sync.Mutex, maxConns int (from AF_SSE_MAX_CONNECTIONS, default 100), tickerFactory func(d time.Duration) *time.Ticker

Define SSEOption as a functional option type and provide WithTickerFactory(fn func(d time.Duration) *time.Ticker) SSEOption for test-time clock injection; the default tickerFactory uses time.NewTicker
Define sseConn struct with: ch chan interface{} (buffered 256), filters (workspace, run_id, category), lastRead time.Time
Implement Register(*sseConn) error — returns error if len(connections) >= maxConns
Implement Unregister(connID) to remove connection and close its channel
Implement NewSSEManager(maxConns int, opts ...SSEOption) *SSEManager; in tests inject a fake ticker via WithTickerFactory that fires immediately to avoid 30-second real waits

subtasks.title: Implement broadcaster goroutine and per-client fan-out with backpressure
details: Implement Run(ctx context.Context) goroutine that reads from broadcast channel and fans out to all registered sseConn channels
When a per-client channel is full (len(ch) == 256), drop the oldest event by draining one item before sending; log dropped event at debug level using slog
Implement Broadcast(event interface{}) to send to the broadcast channel non-blocking
Apply workspace, run_id, and category filters per connection before forwarding

subtasks.title: Implement heartbeat goroutine and stale-connection reaper
details: Define constants: HeartbeatInterval = 30 * time.Second, StaleTimeout = 60 * time.Second
Implement heartbeat goroutine that ticks every HeartbeatInterval and broadcasts a heartbeat event {timestamp: apikit.FormatUTC(apikit.NowUTC())}
Implement stale-connection reaper that checks lastRead on each connection every HeartbeatInterval and calls Unregister for connections where time.Since(lastRead) > StaleTimeout
Both goroutines respect ctx cancellation
